frame: metres, +Z down-range, +Y up, +X to the shooter's left; origin at socket_mount (the rifle's socket_muzzle). s = z*1000 + 52 mm is the recipe's axis

parts.name: lock_collar
parts.role: locking collar: a 60 degree turn cams the three jaws shut behind the flash hider

parts.name: mount_body
parts.role: mount: seats over the flash hider and closes the rear of the blast chamber

parts.name: blast_baffle
parts.role: blast baffle: the first and thickest cone, no clip

parts.name: baffle_2
parts.role: cone baffle 2 of 6 with its spacer skirt; clip at 90 degrees

parts.name: baffle_3
parts.role: cone baffle 3 of 6 with its spacer skirt; clip at 270 degrees

parts.name: baffle_4
parts.role: cone baffle 4 of 6 with its spacer skirt; clip at 90 degrees

parts.name: baffle_5
parts.role: cone baffle 5 of 6 with its spacer skirt; clip at 270 degrees

parts.name: baffle_6
parts.role: cone baffle 6 of 6 with its spacer skirt; clip at 90 degrees

parts.name: end_cap
parts.role: end cap with the exit aperture and six spanner notches

parts.name: jaw_1
parts.role: locking jaw: closes on the jam ring behind the flash hider, so the hider cannot pull out

parts.name: jaw_2
parts.role: locking jaw: closes on the jam ring behind the flash hider, so the hider cannot pull out

parts.name: jaw_3
parts.role: locking jaw: closes on the jam ring behind the flash hider, so the hider cannot pull out

parts.name: marking_panel
parts.role: plain placeholder panel (no maker, model or serial marks)

parts.name: index_panel
parts.role: plain index mark: lines up with the collar mark when locked

parts.name: collar_index
parts.role: plain index mark on the collar

socket_mount.note: mates to the rifle's socket_muzzle (the tip of the flash hider) with an identity transform

socket_exit.note: centre of the end-cap aperture: the new muzzle for flash, smoke, sound and the bullet

socket_thermal.note: top of the tube over the blast baffle: the hottest skin, for glow and mirage

suppressor.note: root; parent it to the rifle's socket_muzzle. The qd clips move it along the bore.

lock_collar.note: turns about the bore: 0 degrees locked, 60 degrees open

jaws.note: jaw_1..3 slide radially 1.3 mm: in = locked on the jam ring, out = clear of the flash hider

qd_attach.note: the open can is slid back over the flash hider until the mount seats on the hider shoulder, then the collar is turned 60 degrees: its cam drives the three jaws in behind the hider

qd_detach.note: the reverse: collar turned open, jaws out, can drawn forward off the hider
